checks.finding: REQ-005 (requirements.md:169-179) says OQ-006 fixes the Pack's predicates, facets, review checks, and implementation gates. OQ-006 (requirements.md:534-569) gives the two capability IDs and broad composition/policy, but does not state those concrete rules; its clarification says A9 will add the IDs to a Registry currently containing only durable-workflow. AC-008 (acceptance-tests.md:14) only requires that an approved Pack validate and resolve. An implementer cannot determine the intended Pack behavior, so different implementations and tests could result. This is a Phase-1 specification gap; those product rules should be made explicit before design review.

No direct conflict found between the reviewed requirements, acceptance criteria, constraints, or non-goals. The Phase-1 and Phase-2 tuples are distinct and defined; the Phase-2 missing-evidence rejection is covered by AC-033.

The resolved OQ-003 lists four independent promotion prerequisites (requirements.md:496-505): zero untriaged false positives, zero unresolved Critical/Major findings, all three OS lanes green, and a successful rollback rehearsal. AC-013/TEST-013 (acceptance-tests.md:19) says only that an unmet threshold rejects, without a concrete assertion for each prerequisite. AC-020/TEST-020 similarly claims to cover any absent or incompatible A1-A8 surface in requirements.md:314, while acceptance-tests.md:26 specifies only one generic surface case. A verifier cannot establish that each enumerated branch blocks promotion or preflight. This is an acceptance-test coverage defect and should be expanded into separately asserted cases before review proceeds.

The dated OQ-006 clarification asserts that the current Registry contains only durable-workflow (requirements.md:555-563), and that claim affects the Pack composition decision. REQ-011 requires re-scanning the Registry before implementation (requirements.md:244-251), but the specification does not require re-verifying this shared current-tree fact at spec-review time, when it informs the review conclusion. If the Registry changes before review, the stated basis may be stale. Add an explicit review-time re-verification instruction or frame the claim so its review-time condition is clear.

REQ-007 requires human authorization for promotion (requirements.md:190-197), and REQ-008 requires the protected approval workflow for the Phase-2 transition (requirements.md:199-207). AC-002 tests the Phase-1 human-copy boundary, but the Phase-2 criteria cover tuple acceptance, partial-transition rejection, and missing evidence without testing that promotion is rejected absent valid human approval (acceptance-tests.md:18-21, 39). A direct transition after satisfying the evidence criteria could therefore pass the specified tests. Add an observable Phase-2 approval-boundary criterion; this is a governance boundary within the specification's stated scope.

The specification is not ready for implementation-policy review because the concrete Pack predicates, facets, review checks, and gates that REQ-005 calls fixed are not stated in the reviewed Phase-1 artifacts (requirements.md:169-179, 534-569; acceptance-tests.md:14). The design reviewer would have to invent those product behaviors or consult an unspecified decision source. Specify them and give AC-008 an oracle tied to that contract.
